title: Asking about TaxSimba packages

transcript.content: What Self Assessment packages does TaxSimba offer?

TaxSimba offers three Self Assessment packages for the tax year:

1. **Self Assessment Simple**: £119 per tax year.
2. **Self Assessment Smart**: £149 per tax year.
3. **Self Assessment Elite**: £299 per tax year.

Each package provides different levels of service. If you need more details about what each package includes, feel free to ask!
How do they differ in price?

Here is what SIMBA can state from approved catalogue decisions:

Self Assessment (per tax year): Simple £119 · Smart £149 · Elite £299.
Making Tax Digital (per month, VAT included): Simbian Comply £29.99 · Simbian Growth £59.99 · Simbian Elite £89.99.
Accountant video consultations: Quick Tax Advice £99 for 20 minutes · Extended Tax Consultation £149 for 40 minutes (Google Meet; no filing, bookkeeping or written report). No free callbacks. Booking path: choose an option → Calendly event → pay within Calendly → Meet. Online booking may be unavailable here — email is only a fallback enquiry route.

Self Assessment is usually a once-a-year tax return service. Making Tax Digital (Simbian) is an ongoing monthly service for people who need digital records and MTD support.

What is approved to say:
- Xero software is included in each Simbian monthly price (£29.99 / £59.99 / £89.99 VAT included) — customers do not pay separately.
- Simbian Comply includes Xero Simple; Growth includes Xero Ignite; Elite includes Xero Grow.
- Support is via email and the client dashboard — not telephone onboarding.
- Bookkeeping is within the agreed engagement scope with no fixed monthly transaction caps (not unlimited out-of-scope work).
- Quarterly MTD updates and year-end Self Assessment are included in all three Simbian plans, subject to documented customer responsibilities.

I will not invent priority support, quarterly business reviews, proactive tax planning, free callbacks, or extra charges.

I can recommend the lowest suitable package for your circumstances. Review packages at https://www.taxsimba.co.uk/self-assessment and https://www.taxsimba.co.uk/making-tax-digital, or start registration at https://www.taxsimba.co.uk/register.
- Self Assessment Simple: £119 (per tax year)
- Self Assessment Smart: £149 (per tax year)
- Self Assessment Elite: £299 (per tax year)
- Simbian Comply: £29.99 (per month; VAT included)
- Simbian Growth: £59.99 (per month; VAT included)
- Simbian Elite: £89.99 (per month; VAT included)
I am a first-time sole trader with simple income — which one do you recommend?

For a first-time sole trader with simple income, I recommend the **Self Assessment Simple** package at £119 per tax year. This package is designed for straightforward tax situations and should meet your needs effectively.

If you're also looking for ongoing support with Making Tax Digital, consider the **Simbian Comply** package at £29.99 per month, which includes Xero Simple for managing your records.

Would you like more information on how to register for either package?

The **Self Assessment Simple** package is ideal for first-time sole traders with straightforward income because it offers a cost-effective solution tailored for simpler tax situations. It provides the essential support needed to file your Self Assessment tax return without the complexities that might come with more advanced packages.

This package allows you to focus on your business while ensuring you meet your tax obligations efficiently. If your situation changes or becomes more complex in the future, you can always upgrade to a more comprehensive package later.

If you have any specific concerns or questions about your situation, feel free to share!
